caption:
133,040 ratings later, this $9.47 blackout curtain still holds a 4.6.

Blackout curtains either block light or they don't, and that's easy to fake in a product photo. It's harder to fake across 133,040 separate reviews. That volume on one specific 42 by 63 inch, black, two-panel set is the kind of sample size a single glowing description can't match.

This listing is a 42 inch wide by 63 inch long two-panel set in black, made for a standard bedroom window. A 4.6-star average holding steady across 133,040 reviews points to consistent performance, not a handful of lucky units.

For a bedroom window that needs real light control, the size fits standard frames and the price is $9.47 for the pair.
